title: Quite Good, but Not Enough: Nationality Bias in Large Language Models - A Case Study of ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Generating discourses about people from 195 countries using stereotyping, neutral, and strength/weakness prompts in Chinese and English. The generated texts are evaluated using automated metrics (vocabulary richness, sentiment, offensiveness, hate speech, and regard) as well as a pair-wise comparison framework to rank offensiveness versus friendliness using expert human annotators and ChatGPT self-evaluation.
